headline: Renewed Base Traffic Marks Contested Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Marban Hollow and Nevish Line have logged fresh base activity, while Weathered Expanse remains the busiest ledger. War 140 has no recorded victor; the stated requirement is 34 victory towns. Weathered Expanse recorded 60 base-event entries in 24 hours, up from 52, including six in the latest two hours; its nine bases stand five Colonial, one Warden and three neutral. Nevish Line rose from 23 daily entries to 35, though only one fell in the latest two hours; its eight bases are divided four to four. Marban Hollow climbed from 26 to 37 entries and logged five in the latest two hours; four bases are Colonial, two Warden and two neutral. Kuura Strand eased from 31 entries to 29, with two in the latest two hours; its tally remains four Colonial and two Warden. Linn Mercy held at ten daily entries, but none came in the latest two hours. Godcrofts also had no recent entries after six in the day, and all nine bases are now Colonial. Elsewhere, activity was sparse or absent.
